environment: Real Spring, pinned PostgreSQL, production Next.js and Caddy; two independent fresh synthetic Git authorities; Chrome; local HTTP
captureMethod: Unmodified browser frames sampled during one workspace switching flow. Frames include intermediate loading and saving states. GIF uses 1.8 seconds per frame for reading, not measured operation timing. Completed writes are verified separately from both Git authorities.
verified: Unsaved space switch opens in-page confirmation
Cancel retains the first workspace and its draft
Two tabs save the same path into separate Git authorities
Both authorized private image previews render
Reopening unchanged content restores its preview
limitations: Synthetic repositories, loopback HTTP, no external provider provisioning or actual MCP client session in this artifact. This sampled state capture does not establish transition timing.
